title: Tasks
summary: A shared to-do list for the family, with due dates, repeating tasks, reminders and privacy choices.

blocks.text: Tasks are shown in columns: one for each family member, plus **Unassigned**. A task sits in the column of the person it is assigned to. Each column shows how many open tasks it has.

items: Use the filter **All**, **Mine**, **Shared** or **Personal** to narrow the list.
Every task has a status: **To do**, **In progress** or **Done**. Done tasks are tucked away: press **Show done** to see them.
Small icons on a task tell you more: that it repeats, that it is personal, or that it is shared with selected members.

blocks.text: If you see the message that you can view tasks but not change them, your administrator gave you view-only access.

blocks.title: Where to click
items: Quickest way: on the Overview or the Tasks page, type the title in the box **Add a task and press Enter**.
For more options, press **Add task**. A panel opens on the side (on a phone, it fills the screen).
Fill in what you need. Only the title is required.

blocks.text: In the panel you can set:

items: **Assigned to**: who should do it. A personal task always stays with you.
**Due date**, and optionally a **time**. Times use the family time zone, which is shown under the field.

blocks.text: Take out the bins: assigned to Peter, repeats on chosen weekdays (Tuesday and Friday), remind 1 day before.

sections.title: Changing the status and finishing a task

blocks.text: Open a task and choose a new **Status**, or tick the box on the task card to mark it done. Tick it again to bring it back.
To delete a task, open it and press **Delete task**. You are asked to confirm, because a deleted task cannot be brought back.
A repeating task needs a due date. Under **Repeat** you can choose:

items: **On chosen weekdays**: tick the days, for example Monday and Thursday.
**Every month**: on a day of the month, or on the last day. In shorter months it happens on the last day.
**Custom interval**: every number of days, weeks or months.

blocks.text: **Repeat from** decides what the next date is based on. **The schedule** follows the rule no matter when you finish. **When I complete it** counts from the day you actually finish.

When you finish a repeating task, the next one appears with the next date. Use **Skip this occurrence** to jump over one without doing it. **Completed history** in the task shows what you did and skipped. Deleting a repeating task also removes all its future repeats.

Under **Remind me**, choose **At due time**, **15 minutes before**, **1 hour before**, **1 day before** or **No reminder**. A task needs a due date for a reminder, and a time for the options in minutes or hours. Tasks without a time remind you at 08:00.
Reminders arrive by email, push, or both, as you set in [Settings > Notifications](/settings/notifications). See [Turning on reminders](getting-started#notifications).
Under **Who can see this task** you choose one of three options:

items: **Personal**: only you. Not even the administrator can see it. Good for surprises.
**Family**: everyone who has access to Tasks.
**Selected members**: you and the people you pick.

blocks.text: Check the choice before you save a task that should stay private.
